description: CC-08: the PHI-zone routing fail-closed path (I-6), not the DMN-down path. `inference.phi_capable=false` makes EVERY `generate(phi=True, ...)` call this turn raise `PhiZoneRoutingError` (`_harness._phi_capable_for`, additive harness extension). `_classify_llm`'s `except Exception` catches it -> classify failure -> escalate falha_tecnica (module docstring: 'a non-PHI-capable provider raises PhiZoneRoutingError -- this graph does NOT catch that error specially: in `_classify_llm` it is a classify failure -> escalate falha_tecnica'). `_resumo_contexto`/`_respond_llm` then hit the SAME error and degrade to their own documented safe canned text -- neither path ever silently downgrades to a general-zone provider nor to an `inform` outcome. `recorded_llm` is empty: no `generate()` call ever successfully returns a scripted response (every call raises before popping). Synthetic data only. REGOLDEN HEL-04 (2026-09-05): `escalation_severidade` was 'leve'. On this path there is no extraction at all (the classify call itself raised), so the severity is genuinely UNKNOWN and is now `null` -- never a fabricated mildest label. Same principle as HELENA-SEVERIDADE-DEFAULT (already on main) for the other no-classification path: the worker boundary (`escalation.py::_exigir_severidade`) refuses a missing severidade fail-closed, so no notification is published on either channel and the case still reaches the mandatory HITL through the modeled BE_NotifFallbackFailed -> UT_TratarEscalonamento edge.
